en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To become familiar with all technologies of vegetatively propagated planting material, the technical and material equipment of these technologies and the relevant forest nurseries, the use and evaluation of the quality of the grown planting material. Part of the teaching will take place directly in the forest nurseries.

en.content: 1.Legislative regulations for the cultivation and use of vegetative planting material (allowance 2/0)2.General aspects of vegetative propagation (allowance 6/4) a.Distribution of individual methods of vegetative reproductionb.Morphological and physiological aspects of vegetative propagationc.Establishing and caring for stands of ortetsd.Growth stimulantse.Substrates and fertilizationf.Propagation houses and their equipmentg.Other methods of vegetative propagation methods (layering, suckering, shoots, etc.)3.Cutting of coniferous trees (allowance 2/2)4.Cutting of deciduous trees (allowance 2/2)5.Cultivation of poplar and willow planting material (allowance 2/2)6.Grafting (allowance 4/4) a.Graftingb.Inoculation7.In vitro technology (allowance 4/8) a.Nursery equipment, media preparationb.Biotechnology and propagation technology8.Use of vegetative propagation in ornamental nursery (allowance 2/2) a.Propagation of deciduous speciesb.Propagation of coniferous species
